label: ngsRelate genome-wide
notes: global relatedness; family QC

label: ngsRelate per-chromosome
notes: chromosome-specific relatedness signal

label: ngsRelate per-candidate
notes: local relatedness inside an inversion candidate

label: ngsPedigree from genome-wide ngsRelate
notes: pedigree built from a genome-wide relatedness_res

label: Mendelian inheritance per candidate
notes: per-trio mendelian-error rate inside a candidate; consumes a pedigree

label: popstats per candidate (FST / dxy / piN / piS)
notes: manuscript path B: per-candidate windowed FST / dxy / piN / piS between karyotype groups

label: popstats per chromosome
notes: chromosome-wide windowed popstats

label: popstats genome-wide
notes: genome-wide windowed popstats (cohort summary statistics)

label: wfmash pairwise — focal-only (Cgar/Cmac × close relatives)
notes: Pass A -s 100k + Pass B -s 500k; divergence-tiered identity (p90 Clarias / p85 Cranoglanis / p80 mid / skip deep). ~30 pairs on the focal set; runs in hours on a laptop.

label: wfmash pairwise — all-vs-all (18 genomes)
notes: ~240 pairs. SLURM-recommended; deep outgroups (Plotosus, Trichomycterus) auto-skipped (deep tier).

label: BUSCO single-copy ortholog table extraction
notes: Builds wide BUSCO single-copy ortholog tables (synteny18, synteny5). Substrate for gene-order family breakpoint walks across the full catfish phylogeny (gene order persists past p90 sequence limit).

label: STEP_CS01 — sequence breakpoint extraction from PAF
notes: One-PAF, conservative core + TE-flank annotation + candidate overlap hook. --min-mapq 1 (wfmash MAPQ is 1-5).

label: BP_ATLAS two-pass — sequence breakpoint atlas with reciprocity
notes: Pass A -s 100k sensitive + Pass B -s 500k backbone check; BP3c BOTH-anchor reciprocity (zones validated from both Cgar and Cmac frames).

label: Fold methods → cross_method clusters (cluster_breakpoints.py)
notes: Tolerance-clusters across method families (gene_order vs sequence). cross_method=true only when >=2 INDEPENDENT families agree <=tol. Default --tol-kb 500.

label: tract classifier (ngsTracts STEP_TRC_01)
notes: Producer-side ngsTracts; this row registers the adapter that bridges TSV → typed envelope.

label: per-(chrom × dyad) CO/DCO/NCO counts
notes: Derives co_per_mb / dco_per_mb when absent. Karyotype-stratified rows when karyotype_at_focal_inv present.

label: coefficient of coincidence per interval pair
notes: c = r_ab/(r_a·r_b); flags c > neg_interference_threshold (default 3.0). Supports karyo-stratified mode for interchromosomal page.

label: per-tested-chrom local inversion covariates
notes: Filtered subset of inversion_candidates.v1; derives length_bp from end-start+1.

label: per-(focal_inv × parent) null-model assignment
notes: permutation_block = family_id by default; n_singleton_blocks diagnostic for shuffle degeneracy.

label: per-candidate sex-specific CO ideogram + telomere curve
notes: Per-inversion-candidate JSON; consumer also includes genome-atlas page3 CO-density sub-track.

label: per-candidate NCO/GC tract ideogram + telomere curve
notes: Sister track to crossover_track; kind ∈ {nco, gc}.

label: PRDM9 PWM from CO hotspots
notes: Optional. Embedded on same per-candidate crossover JSON.

label: NCO enrichment inside vs outside inversion candidate
notes: CHAIN. Crosstab MOSAIC_SHORT × in/out, Fisher exact; manuscript NCO headline.

label: CO_rate(het) vs CO_rate(non-het) per focal × tested chrom
notes: CHAIN. Cell <0.7 highlight is the manuscript intrachromosomal-effect signal.

label: HEADLINE: focal inversion karyotype → meiosis on OTHER chromosomes
notes: CHAIN. Welch's t on per-parent CO rates (het vs non-het) + family-aware permutation null (shuffle within permutation_block) + BH + Bonferroni across off-focal chrom tests. Currently inlined in interchromosomal/_stats.js — module promotion required before catalogue compute lookup works end-to-end.

label: Tajima's D (windowed)
notes: Single sample set; sliding windows over BEAGLE GLs. Negative D = excess low-freq variants; positive D = excess intermediate-freq variants.

label: Watterson's theta (windowed)
notes: Per-window theta_W from segregating sites.

label: Pooled heterozygosity Hp (windowed)
notes: Pooled-sample heterozygosity per window; low Hp = sweep candidate.

label: Net divergence dA (windowed)
notes: dA = dXY - mean(piA, piB) per window between two sample sets.

label: Individual F_HOM (excess homozygosity)
notes: Per-sample inbreeding-coefficient analog from BEAGLE GLs. Scope (genome/chromosome/interval) is a runtime parameter on the same engine. FHOM > 0 = homozygous-biased (inbred / homokaryotypic for an inverted region).

label: Patterson's D / fdM (windowed, four-pop)
notes: Four-population test (P1, P2, P3, O). Reports Patterson's D and Malinsky 2015 fdM with block jackknife. Sign: positive = excess ABBA = introgression P3 -> P2.

label: iHS (windowed, single-cohort)
notes: Voight 2006 framing, diploid-IBS approximation from unphased BEAGLE GLs (allele 0 assumed ancestral). Freq-binned z-score normalization.

label: XP-EHH (windowed, two-cohort)
notes: Diploid-IBS approximation from unphased BEAGLE GLs. Sign: positive = test cohort has longer extended haplotype homozygosity than ref at the focal.

label: pi_N / pi_S per CDS locus
notes: Per-locus pi_N and pi_S with coverage correction + bootstrap CI. Standard MK-style purifying-selection diagnostic.

label: pi at 0-fold / 4-fold degenerate sites
notes: Per-locus pi at 0-fold (purifying) and 4-fold (~neutral) degenerate sites + pi_0/pi_4 ratio. Same engine as pi_ns.

label: Pairwise dN/dS (NG86 + YN00)
notes: NG86 + YN00 (kappa-corrected) dN/dS and Ka/Ks + 4D-site identity per aligned CDS pair. Ts/Tv breakdown columns included.

label: Hobs per arrangement (windowed)
notes: Per-group (e.g. karyotype arrangement homA / het / homB) observed and expected heterozygosity per sliding window. Hobs collapse inside the inverted interval is the karyotyping signal.

label: Rare-SFS sharing (pairwise)
notes: Pairwise rare-allele SFS sharing matrix across every pair of sample sets. Cluster-by-rare-allele-sharing diagnostic.

label: Outlier scan (any stat)
notes: Statistic-agnostic genome scan. Caller supplies the per-window TSV (output of any prior popstats run) plus the stat column to scan and direction (high | low | abs). Returns merged outlier regions + per-region rank.

label: Inside vs flanks (any stat)
notes: For each candidate, Wilcoxon U + permutation p-value of stat inside vs flanking N-bp windows on either side. Validates candidate against local background, not just global. Supports multiple stat cols per request.

label: Q-residualized genotype dosage
notes: Per-sample residual genotype dosage after removing the additive contribution of global Q. The input matrix to karyotype k-means and to most structural-candidate downstream analyses. Scope is flexible (genome / chrom / interval) as a runtime parameter.

label: Per-SNP Q-support classifier
notes: Pearson |dosage ~ Q_k| per SNP -> soft support vector -> classification + per-window coherence. K is a runtime parameter; same engine call. Feeds the inversion candidate classifier.

label: Interval-internal ancestry composition
notes: Generic across parent-interval types (chromosomes / MDS / inversion candidates). Per (parent x sample) emits dominant-label run-lengths, switches, internal entropy, fragmentation, structure class. Was nested_composition.py.

label: Inversion-candidate classifier (ancestry_driven vs structural)
notes: Per-candidate: coherent_q_loaded_core / likely_mixed_background / likely_parasite_windows + ancestry_class (ancestry_driven vs structural vs mixed) + internal_structure_type. The path-A vs path-B router for the inversion pipeline.

label: Multi-scale Hobs / HWE pipeline
notes: Builds bamlist per subset -> ANGSD -doHWE -> hobs_windower at multiple scales (e.g. 5kb / 10kb / 50kb). Emits per (subset x scale) sliding-window Hobs, Hexp, F, HWE p-value.

label: Hobs / HWE overlay on candidates
notes: For each (candidate x subset x scale): inside vs flank Hobs / F means and medians, outlier burden, distortion pattern classification (homozygous_excess / heterozygote_excess / mixed). The Hobs-collapse karyotyping signal lives here.

label: Resolve karyotype groups (homA / het / homB) vs background
notes: Per-candidate per-sample karyotype call (homA / het / homB) with posterior. Composes q_residual_dosage + hobs overlay; clusters samples within the candidate; compares within-candidate distribution against the genome-wide null. Produces the karyotype_calls that feed inversion_groupwise_popstats.

label: Scan inversion boundaries from instant_q tracks
notes: Walks per-window local Q across a chromosome, change-point-detects Q-composition shifts, emits candidate (chrom, start, end) intervals. Feeds inversion_candidate_classifier and karyotype_resolution downstream. K is a runtime parameter.

label: Inversion-candidate groupwise popstats (chain)
notes: Manuscript path B chain: inversion_karyotypes -> homA / het / homB partition -> popstats_groupwise inside the candidate interval. Composed of region_popstats + hobs_windower under the hood. Returns per-arrangement (theta_pi, Hp, FIS) and pairwise (FST, dXY, dA) popstats restricted to the candidate.

label: Pairwise kinship θ (Jacquard EM)
notes: Scope (genome-wide vs per-chrom) is a runtime parameter; same atomic stat.

label: KING-robust kinship per pair
notes: Boundaries (Manichaikul 2010): 0.354 duplicate, 0.177 first_degree, 0.0884 second_degree, 0.0442 third_degree.

label: Jacquard 9-coefficient EM (J1–J9)
notes: Source J1–J9 in .res. Path untouched by the fork patch (load-bearing for ngsPedigree).

label: IBS0/IBS1/IBS2 counts per pair
notes: IBS0 ≤ 0.008 → parent_offspring vs full_sibling split inside the first-degree KING band.

label: Per-sample inbreeding F (-F)
notes: Selected via the -F flag; replaces the 9-coefficient output.

label: Per-chromosome adaptive relatedness (chain)
notes: Chains derive_priors → budget allocation → multiprocessing dispatch → escalation. Anchor is a genome-wide kinship_theta/king_robust_kinship run. Co-emits adaptive_manifest_tsv + adaptive_run_manifest_json sidecars (referenced by run manifest, not separate registry rows).

label: Adaptive vs uniform-stride 6-gate validator
notes: Tier-1 gates 4+6 are hard fails; tier-2 gate 1 ≥0.90 required; tiers 3 informational. Nonzero exit on any tier-1/2 fail.

label: Import table (default)
notes: Loose staging envelope; normalize via a downstream-specific schema once known.

label: Cactus pairwise alignment (default)
notes: Reserved. Module not yet implemented; placeholder mode.

label: WGDI ancestral karyotype (default)
notes: Reserved. Output layer 'ancestral_karyotype' also not yet declared.

label: Oxford-grid greedy reorder (default)
notes: Reserved. Client-side today; this row marks the slot.

label: Per-pair orthologue lookup (default)
notes: Reserved. Direct file fetch today; entry exists so atlas-core sees the named slot.

label: Genome-wide heterozygosity (per sample)
notes: H = sfs_bin1 / (sfs_bin0 + sfs_bin1). Source: 04_summary/genomewide_heterozygosity.tsv.

label: Folded 1-D SFS (per sample)
notes: realSFS -fold 1 over per-sample SAF; emits 2-value folded SFS.

label: θπ in windows (per sample, any scale)
notes: tP / nSites per window from thetaStat do_stat.

label: Watterson's θ in windows (per sample)
notes: tW column of pestPG.

label: Tajima's D in windows (per sample)
notes: Tajima column of pestPG.

label: θπ aggregated across cohort
notes: Sums tP and nSites across per-sample pestPGs to a cohort track.

label: ROH segments (per sample)
notes: PLANNED — upstream ROH pipeline output empty on disk today.

label: Heterozygosity Kruskal-Wallis test across K clusters
notes: K∈2..12, cohort∈{all226, pruned81}.

label: Heterozygosity ANOVA across K clusters
notes: K∈2..12, cohort∈{all226, pruned81}.

label: Pairwise Wilcoxon between K cluster labels
Pairwise t-test between K cluster labels
Provenance capture of one diversity-atlas slot
notes: slot∈{embedded_tables, texture_metrics, functional_burden, roh_gene_overlap, divergence_network}.

label: Per-sample diversity envelope (CHAIN)
notes: CHAIN — composes genomewide_heterozygosity + sfs_folded_1d + theta_pi_windows + roh_per_sample (planned) into one per-sample envelope.

label: Ancestry × heterozygosity test battery (CHAIN)
notes: CHAIN — composes ancestry_het_kruskal + ancestry_het_anova + ancestry_het_pairwise_wilcox + ancestry_het_pairwise_ttest + ancestry_q_correlations. Required dimensions K∈2..12, cohort∈{all226, pruned81}.

label: Per-sample master table (CHAIN)
notes: CHAIN — composes genomewide_heterozygosity + roh_per_sample + ngsF-HMM convergence + K=8 labels into a per-sample master row. PLANNED — blocked on roh_per_sample.

label: Haplotype projection from pedigree
notes: relationship_type (dyad|triad) is a runtime parameter, not a registry row. Per-variant projection_source ∈ {parent_homozygous, parent_heterozygous_phased, parent_heterozygous_unphased}; per-segment confidence ∈ {Gold, Silver, Bronze}.

label: Per-gene haplotype-resolved status
notes: Damaging set follows KBC §1.8 tier (Tier 1 / 2 / 3) selected at runtime. Segment confidence (Gold/Silver/Bronze) and per-variant projection_source propagated into the gene-status row.

label: Per-relationship transmission summary
notes: relationship_type (dyad|triad) runtime param. Triad rows carry full Mendelian + n_de_novo_candidates; dyad rows carry partial Mendelian (parent-hom sites only). No family-hub aggregation under any scope.

label: HPP × KBC arrangement-assignment cross-check
notes: Runs only on variants where both HPP and KBC have made an assignment. Discordances expected at inversion edges and in Bronze segments; reported as diagnostic, not primary result.

label: HPP per-offspring pipeline (chain)
notes: Chains Stage 2 pedigree set → Stage 3 maps → haplotype_projection → offspring_gene_status. Optional terminal blocs: transmission_summary, hpp_kbc_arrangement_crosscheck. Headline product is hpp_offspring_gene_status (manuscript supplementary table). Three-cohort rule absolute: 226-sample pure C. gariepinus hatchery only.
